newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks pare gains, shadow Telmex.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks pare gains, shadow Telmex.

text.p: Mexican stocks moderated early gains in line with market heavyweight to stand slightly up at light mid-session trading, dealers said.
"Telmex has gone of the boil, and secondary interest rates are down, but otherwise nothing much is happening, foreign investors are not much interested in the bourse," a desk trader said..
The leading IPC share index .MXX was up 3.64 points, or 0.10 percent, at 3,838.22. Trading volume .TV.MX was light at 35.4 million shares. Telmex L class shares were up 10 centavos to 16.68 pesos.
